meta.title: Start a deal
meta.description: Source a product, supply a product or offer a trade service. Build it by tapping, preview exactly what each party sees, then submit for Ponte review.

structure.trust: Build and preview freely. Join only when you save or submit.

intent.title: What do you want to do?
intent.buyDesc: I need to buy or import
intent.serviceDesc: Freight, customs, inspection, finance or another trade service

facts.reward: Ponte structured {facts} facts. {gaps} details still needed.

classify.chooseCategory: Choose the closest category. You can add detail afterwards.
classify.choosePartner: Choose the partner or channel type.
classify.chooseRelationship: How would the arrangement be structured? Choose any that apply.
classify.noOptionMatch: No option matches that. Choose Other to describe it in your own words.
classify.describeServiceNeed: Describe the trade service you need
classify.describeServiceOffer: Describe the trade service you provide
classify.describeHint: Ponte keeps your wording and still records the category you chose.
classify.detailsOptional: Optional. Route, volume, timing, certifications, target customer or commercial conditions.
classify.detailsPlaceholder: Anything that helps a counterparty judge the fit
classify.sectorOptional: Optional. Choose a sector if you know it.
classify.relationshipOptional: Optional. Leave this open if it is negotiable.

ask.destination: Where does it need to go?
ask.validity: How long does this stay open?
ask.serviceScopeNeeded: What do you need the service to cover?
ask.serviceScopePlaceholder: What is provided or required, and anything it excludes
ask.serviceEngagement: Is this a one-off engagement or an ongoing arrangement?
ask.serviceTradeLanesPlaceholder: Optional. e.g. Barcelona to Northern Europe
ask.serviceCapability: What capacity or capability can you commit?
ask.serviceCapabilityPlaceholder: e.g. up to 40 containers per month, 12,000 pallet positions, response within 24 hours
ask.servicePricingBasis: How is the service charged for?
ask.distributionObjective: What are you looking to achieve?
ask.distributionObjectivePlaceholder: e.g. find an exclusive national distributor for a premium food range
ask.distributionChannelsSought: Which sales channels should the partner reach?
ask.distributionChannelsOffered: Which sales channels do you reach?
ask.distributionExpectationsPlaceholder: Exclusivity, sales targets, opening order, margin, marketing investment or trial period
ask.serviceCapabilityNeeded: What capacity does the work require?
ask.serviceCapabilityNeededPlaceholder: e.g. about 40 containers per month, 12,000 pallet positions, response within 24 hours
ask.servicePricingBasisNeeded: How do you expect to be quoted?
ask.serviceAvailabilityNeeded: When do you need it from?
ask.distributionObjectiveRepresent: What are you looking to take on?
ask.distributionObjectiveRepresentPlaceholde: e.g. represent a premium food brand entering the Spanish market
ask.distributionExpectationsOffered: What do you expect from the brand or supplier?
ask.distributionExpectationsOfferedPlacehold: Exclusivity, margin, marketing support, training, stock terms or contract length

preview.title: See exactly what each party sees.
preview.publicNote: What buyers see before an introduction. Identity withheld.
preview.privateNote: Held by Ponte. Never shown publicly.
preview.reviewerNote: What a Ponte reviewer assesses. Dated evidence, never a score.

submit.title: Ready when the record is.
submit.sub: {n, plural, =1 {One thing} other {# things}} must be resolved before Ponte can publish. You can save a draft now and finish later.

blocker.quantityDesc: A decisive fact a reviewer needs before publication.
blocker.incotermDesc: The delivery basis must be stated to publish.
blocker.validityDesc: Ponte publishes only opportunities with a stated horizon.
blocker.roleDesc: State the role you act in for this opportunity.
blocker.serviceClassificationDesc: Choose the service category and the detail inside it, or describe it in your own words.
blocker.serviceScopeDesc: Say what the service includes so a counterparty can judge the fit.
blocker.serviceCoverageDesc: State the countries, corridors or markets this service covers.
blocker.distributionPartnerDesc: Choose the partner or channel type this opportunity is about.
blocker.distributionObjectiveDesc: Say what you are seeking or offering, so a counterparty knows what is on the table.
blocker.distributionProductScopeDesc: Name the products, brands or sectors this arrangement covers.
blocker.distributionTerritoryDesc: State where the arrangement applies. Return to the coverage question to name it.
blocker.declarationDesc: Confirm the information is accurate, that you are authorised to submit it, and that publication is not verification by Ponte.
blocker.businessVerificationDesc: Publication needs a current member-business verification. You can still submit for review now.

received.title: Opportunity submitted for review
received.body: Ponte will review the structured record before anything is published.
received.draftBody: Your draft is saved privately. Finish and submit it whenever you are ready.
received.publishedBody: It passed Ponte's checks and is on the market now. Nobody had to approve it by hand.
received.publishedDisclaimer: Publication means your listing passed Ponte's structural and safety checks. Ponte has not independently verified the commercial claims in it.
received.needsInfoTitle: Your offer is saved, but a few required details are missing.
received.needsInfoBody: Ponte publishes automatically once these are complete.
received.flaggedTitle: Your offer needs an additional check before publication.
received.flaggedBody: Most listings publish immediately. This one matched a check that Ponte looks at by hand. This is not a finding against you.
received.verifyOnlyTitle: Your offer is ready. Your business is not verified yet.
received.verifyOnlyBody: Ponte publishes member opportunities from verified businesses only. Nothing is wrong with your listing: it publishes automatically as soon as your verification passes.
received.verifyOnlyNote: Verifying confirms the legal entity you represent. It is not an assessment of the opportunity you posted.

error.title: Ponte kept your words.
error.body: Something interrupted the submission. Nothing you tapped is lost. Try again.
